svg.title: One plugin, three skills, five specialists
svg.text: One plugin, three skills, five specialists
Slash commands enter a skill; skills delegate to agents; everything leaves a file you can audit.
KK · KU · UK · UU → pick technique(s); capture the prior;
high stakes: ledger, regret, dual gate
delegates when isolation or independent judgement pays
[ 03 ] AGENTS · DELEGATED WHEN THE CASE PAYS
adversarial review of a diff or design
gate on blast radius, not confidence
the irreversible lane always waits for the user
